summary.headline: Your business texting registration has been sent in, and your new ads are coming next week.
summary.body: Done: the website is live in English and Spanish, the first issue of The Weekly went out Nov 24, and the texting registration was submitted Nov 25 with your business approved. Next: the texting campaign part came back rejected, so we are fixing and resending it, and ads for new clients and agent recruiting come to you for approval by Monday, Nov 30. Still open: the small website changes from Maria's notes, cancelling roomvu, Facebook access from Creative One and the Google Workspace setup.
summary.needs_you: Yilian: save the card for Google Workspace in the password vault, send Maria's own photos for the newsletter, and update your website link and logo everywhere. Maria: review the new ads on Monday, register the DBA and book a photo shoot after your trip.
summary.next_call: Thu, Dec 3, 10:30 AM ET (9:30 AM CT). No call this week for Thanksgiving.
